packageRules.description: Nano1 uses JetPack 7.2 with the CUDA 13.2 and TensorRT 10.16 runtime line. Newer NGC TensorRT images require a newer host runtime.
kafka-clients 4.4.0 removes org.apache.kafka.common.utils.ByteUtils, which Confluent 8.3.2's SchemaId serializer and the wire-format interop tests still reference.
maven-resolver-provider 3.10.x pulls in maven-resolver 2.x, which drops DefaultTrackingFileManager and breaks maven-resolver-supplier 1.9.x.

Non-major updates arrive as one pull request rather than one per dependency. Five were open at once in 2026-08, most of them a single line, and each one costs a full suite run. Majors stay ungrouped so each can be judged alone.
